test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: More households purchased electric vehicles this year compared to last year.

Conclusions:

I. Electric vehicles are becoming the preferred choice for families.

II. Traditional fuel-based cars are no longer being manufactured. ?
solution:
Given statement: More households purchased electric vehicles this year compared to last year

Conclusions:

I. Electric vehicles are becoming the preferred choice for families.. ⇒ True

An increase in sales supports the trend of electric vehicles becoming a preferred choice.

II. Traditional fuel-based cars are no longer being manufactured. ⇒ False

This is completely unrelated and not supported by the statement.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
